identity.method: exact Git administrative text files; no Git executable

scope.source_limit: Six directly indexed tools/fetch/paths/arguments/system/constant source files; reused already-qualified CMake/helper and tool-boundary sources only.

command_ledger.command: /usr/bin/python3 -B heredoc; SHA512 verification and exact ZIP directory-index read
/usr/bin/python3 -B heredoc; SHA512 and commit-comment recheck, six canonical regular source members plus MIT license extracted, private source manifest written

other_tools: node_repl filesystem and crypto APIs only; successful reads, hashes and private receipt write; no subprocesses or secret/environment inspection

controls.requirement: Set in the actual native process environment; the implementation tests presence, not value.
Unset rather than set to 0 or empty. If present and a download is available, consider_system becomes false and consider_downloads remains true even when FORCE_SYSTEM is also present.

controls.setting: PATH begins with the qualified absolute CMake and Ninja executable directories
controls.requirement: Use directories from the accepted host-tool receipts, validate selected executable paths and hashes, and run their exact --version witnesses only after native admission. No exact-version pin is created by FORCE_SYSTEM.

managed_tools.selection: CMake and Ninja have system-search providers. With FORCE_SYSTEM present and FORCE_DOWNLOADED absent, their downloaded candidates and fallback acquisition are excluded; the first acceptable regular PATH/system candidate is chosen. Without forcing, the already-downloaded candidate is preferred before PATH. This is not a universal no-download switch for providers that have no system executable names.
managed_tools.version_and_abi_caveat: Forced-system selection skips version probing and returns internal version string 0. The existing package-ABI code obtains CMake version through this tool cache, so the normal cmake ABI entry no longer identifies 4.4.4. Bind the managed CMake binary or an immutable tool-identity receipt into explicit ABI inputs, and retain separate native version/hash witnesses; include Ninja identity in the frozen operation contract.
managed_tools.exact_version_switch: --x-abi-tools-use-exact-versions refers to the vcpkg tool metadata version for ABI-sensitive providers, not to a caller-supplied 4.4.4 pin. The retained port prerequisite records fallback CMake 4.4.3. FORCE_SYSTEM bypasses this version comparison too.

ninja_routes.route: When FORCE_SYSTEM is defined, find_program searches ninja/ninja-build. For Ninja generation the helper passes the selected NINJA path as CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM. An already-populated NINJA variable makes the acquisition helper return immediately, so stale cached paths must be excluded.

FORCE_SYSTEM suppresses the ordinary Ninja acquisition/path/CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM injection block. The detector CMake Ninja generator therefore needs its own actual CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM/PATH witness; a real-port witness does not prove this branch.

ninja_routes.context: Any helper acquisition that reaches fetch
ninja_routes.route: The NINJA helper calls vcpkg fetch ninja --x-stderr-status; command_fetch delegates to paths.get_tool_path and prints the selected path. This provides a future bounded selection witness, not a command executed here.

root_controls.env: VCPKG_ROOT may match this path; CLI takes precedence.
root_controls.reason: Prefer an operation-owned copy so any source-adjacent Git index/object writes cannot target the separately qualified source checkout. If using CMake integration, invoke its identical copied vcpkg.cmake: the integration explicitly supplies --vcpkg-root from Z_VCPKG_ROOT_DIR, so an environment-only override is insufficient.
Avoid implicit manifest discovery selecting an unintended project. CMake integration already supplies its selected manifest directory.

Tools live under downloads/tools and artifacts under downloads/artifacts. The ordinary mutable-checkout default is source-root/downloads; a read-only bundle defaults to platform cache. Explicit CLI wins over the environment fallback.

root_controls.root: buildtrees, logs, detector and version extraction
root_controls.reason: Versioning baseline/port-tree output derives from buildtrees/versioning_. Without the explicit argument, an ordinary checkout defaults to root/buildtrees.
Ordinary checkout default is root/packages; source selection confirms the explicit override.

root_controls.root: installed packages and vcpkg installed metadata
root_controls.cmake: Set VCPKG_INSTALLED_DIR to the corresponding private path; integration passes --x-install-root.
root_controls.reason: Defaults are source-root/installed in classic mode or manifest-root/vcpkg_installed in manifest mode. Installed lockfile serialization and compiler-hash cache must remain beneath this private installed tree; exact native locations still require witnessing.

root_controls.root: registry Git cache, trees and registry locks
root_controls.reason: Override must be an existing absolute directory. Git state is registries/git/.git, trees registries/git-trees, and registry lock registries/git/.vcpkg-lock. Exporting the env override also covers recursively launched fetch processes that do not repeat the CLI option.
On this non-Windows branch it replaces HOME/.cache and vcpkg appends /vcpkg. Use an absolute private path. This does not redirect HOME/.vcpkg configuration.

root_controls.control: For initial offline qualification, explicitly disable binary caching with --feature-flags=-binarycaching; omit --binarysource and exclude inherited provider configuration.
root_controls.reason: The inspected argument parser supports the negative binarycaching feature flag and accepts VCPKG_BINARY_SOURCES/--binarysource. VCPKG_DEFAULT_BINARY_CACHE is a named interface, but its provider grammar and root implementation are outside the six-source bound. No binary cache root is admitted by this receipt. If caching is later enabled, require a separately qualified explicit private provider root instead of a HOME default.

metrics_locks_and_offline.control: --disable-metrics plus VCPKG_DISABLE_METRICS=1 in the launch environment
metrics_locks_and_offline.source_fact: CLI and presence-based environment input set disable_metrics; recursive tool calls explicitly disable metrics as well. Actual suppression of all user-configuration/metrics writes is not implemented in these inspected files.

metrics_locks_and_offline.control: Retain --x-wait-for-lock and normal exclusive locking; omit --x-ignore-lock-failures and unset X_VCPKG_IGNORE_LOCK_FAILURES
metrics_locks_and_offline.source_fact: Both lock switches are parsed; the environment variable enables ignore_lock_failures when no explicit setting exists. Registry routines take exclusive locks under the selected private registry root. These interfaces are not a demonstrated no-write-lock mode. CMake integration supplies --x-wait-for-lock.

metrics_locks_and_offline.control: --no-downloads with all exact archive inputs preseeded and hash-verified under the private download root
metrics_locks_and_offline.source_fact: Build args pass _VCPKG_NO_DOWNLOADS; the retained distfile helper checks cached SHA512 first and rejects an uncached file when downloads are disabled. Tool fallback and registry Git fetch are separate paths; this is not a global network ban.

Transport and environment/CLI combination are source-confirmed, including recursive forwarding. Asset-cache directive grammar and origin-block enforcement were not inspected within the six-source cap, so no directive is promoted to an offline guarantee.

explicit_caveats.statement: get_user_configuration_home returns HOME/.vcpkg on non-Windows, independent of XDG_CACHE_HOME. Read-only-bundle global configuration uses that home. XDG cache redirection alone cannot prove HOME unchanged; disable metrics, avoid global integration/configuration operations, and witness or enforce no HOME writes. HOME was not changed or repurposed in this review.

get_builtin_ports_directory_trees copies the discovered source index to <index>_vcpkg_<pid>.tmp beside that index, stages against the temporary index, and writes a tree in that repository. Its use by the eventual install call graph is not established in this bounded inspection. Final unchanged tracked-file bytes cannot prove no transient source/.git writes. The parent may choose a hash-verified operation-private root to contain this possibility.

Selected registry routines initialize and fetch into the private Git cache. Download-root/asset controls alone do not prove this Git path cannot use the network. The offline operation needs preseeded required objects plus native failure/traffic witnesses or an admitted network boundary.

Binary-cache provider implementation, installed lock acquisition, metrics/configuration writers, operating-system temp handling and complete child-tool write behavior are not fully covered by the six selected files. Exact accepted controls and root derivations are recorded; exhaustive runtime confinement is not claimed.

later_native_witnesses.expected: Under the final launch environment, fetch cmake and fetch ninja resolve exactly to qualified paths and hashes; independent --version results are 4.4.4 and 1.13.2. Record actual CMAKE_COMMAND and CMAKE_MAKE_PROGRAM in detector, port Debug/Release and application contexts.

Reject wrong/shadowed/missing managed paths through operation preflight; ensure FORCE_DOWNLOADED is absent. Existing private fallback downloads must not win selection. Observe internal version 0 under forced mode and explicit ABI binding for CMake identity.

Use only operation-owned manifest/source/cache/install/build/package/temp roots. Attest attempted writes, including transient Git index/object and lock writes, rather than relying only on final hashes. Qualified original checkout/common Git directory and real HOME remain unchanged.

Verify actual recursive fetch/root/download/registry settings and disabled metrics in the child context without environment dumps. Source recursively forwards root/download/assets and disables metrics; not every CLI root is serialized.

With exact port archives and registry objects preseeded, no provider/tool/network acquisition occurs. Remove a required archive/object only in a disposable control and observe an offline failure rather than fallback download/fetch.

Locks and installed lockfile writes occur only in private roots, without ignored failures. Disabled binary-cache mode neither restores from nor uploads to inherited/default providers. Metrics/user-configuration writes are absent or blocked under the admitted boundary.

completion: Source-only prerequisite complete within the explicit cap. Native managed-tool selection, offline execution and write confinement remain unverified; no task12a1 implementation was reviewed or altered.
